pages.text:
A huge energy store, for whole bases.
# Building
- A box 3 to 5 blocks along each side (it needn't be a cube).
- Its twelve edges are Battery Array Casings. Its faces are casings or Pressure Glass.
- One Battery Array Controller sits in a side face (not on an edge), facing out. Right-click it to open its GUI, or wrench it to check the build.
- The inside (1 to 27 blocks) is filled entirely with Lithium Cells and Power Regulators, in any mix, with at least one cell.
Breaking any block of it un-forms it.

# Cells and regulators
| Tier | Lithium Cell | Power Regulator |
| Wrought | 64M FE | 65,536 FE/t |
| Tempered | 512M FE | 262,144 FE/t |
| Hardened | 4G FE | 1,048,576 FE/t |
| Arcforged | 32G FE | 4,194,304 FE/t |
The cells add up to its capacity, the regulators to how much it takes in and gives out each tick (each way). With no regulators it still moves 16,384 FE/t.
Its energy is shared between the cells: a cell broken out of it keeps its share on the item, and a new array starts with what its cells hold.

# Ports and control
A new array has no ports: set Energy Input and Energy Output ports on any casing (or the controller) with the Wrench in Port mode. Output ports push into whatever touches them.
- Through the glass the cells' windows light up level by level as it fills, and the controller glows brighter the fuller it is.
- A comparator on the controller reads how full it is.
- Redstone control pauses the output (it still charges).
